subject: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception

Hi all,

TL;DR: Requesting an exception to elevate Arjun Singh (SRE, currently IC4) to a temporary band IC5 for the next 12 months and grant a one-time 0.5% equity refresh and a prorated on-call stipend. This is a narrow exception tied to his taking the Oncall Lead role for the new multi-region infra rollout.

Why: Arjun has been the primary oncall coordinator for the last 9 months and is effectively acting at the next band — he owns cross-region playbooks, runbook automation, and has reduced paging noise by ~28% (see attached impact summary). We cannot fill this role externally within the quarter without service risk.

Ask:
- People: approve a band elevation (temporary, 12 months) + formal title update to "Oncall Lead (SRE)"
- Comp: 0.5% one-time equity refresh, plus a prorated on-call stipend (~$8K) for the remainder of 2026
- Finance: confirm headcount/comp run impact and approve funding source (ops run vs. contingency)

Attachments: arjun_oncall_impact_summary.pdf, cost_impact_2026Q4.xlsx

Notes: I tried to keep this constrained — not a broad band change for the org, strictly an operational exception for continuity. Happy to walk through the metrics in a quick call.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, SRE
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. I reviewed the impact summary quickly. A few quick asks before I escalate to the compensation committee: 

1) Please add one example incident timeline where Arjun owned the postmortem and reduced recurrence (1-2 paragraphs).
2) Confirm whether this is retroactive to 11/1/2026 or starts upon approval.
3) Confirm manager calibration: does the team manager (not on this thread) support the temporary band move and title change?

If you can add the supplemental paragraph and confirm the start date, I will prepare the packet and route to BrightPath Compensation Committee for an external precedent check. We will also need Marcus to sign off on the funding line.

Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception

Monica — thanks. Additional details below and in updated attachment (see arjun_oncall_impact_summary.pdf v2 in Notion link).

Incident example (short):
- On 2026-09-14 a cascading network misconfiguration in us-west caused a 60-minute service degradation. Arjun led the triage, owned the cross-team comms, executed a config rollback + automated validation script that prevented recurrence. He authored the postmortem and pushed a remediation (automation) that eliminated the manual step causing the original misconfiguration. Time-to-detect improved by ~18m across affected services.

Start date: Requesting approval effective 2026-11-01 (pro-rated stipend and equity vesting mechanics to be handled by Comp/Payroll).

Manager calibration: Confirmed — manager Priya Natarajan supports and documented concurrence in her 2026-11-07 note (attached to the Notion link).

Link to updated packet: https://redwood.notion.site/Comp-Exception-Arjun-2026-11-08

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception

Team — I ran a quick comp precedent scan and consulted our standard exception rubric. Recommendation: approve temporary band elevation (12 mo) + 0.5% one-time equity refresh, with two conditions:

1) Equity cliff: one-time refresh vests over 12 months (monthly pro-rata) and is tied to retention through 11/01/2027.
2) Title and band will be explicitly labeled "temporary/oncall assignment" in HR systems to prevent unintended calibration drift.

I've prepared a draft approval memo for Laura's signature and a DocuSign envelope for Marcus to sign the funding acknowledgement. Drafts are in the Notion link. If Laura signs off, Monica can route externally to BrightPath for precedent confirmation (fast-tracked).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: band elevation + one-time equity for Oncall Lead (SRE) - exception

Laura/Monica/Team — Finance reviewed the cost_impact_2026Q4.xlsx. We can absorb the ~$24.5K incremental run for the remainder of 2026 within the SRE ops budget (one-time funding). Confirming funding approval, provided Neha's conditions are implemented (vesting schedule + HR system labeling).

I've attached signed acknowledgement: signed-approval-marcus.pdf. Marcus Lin
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
